intro: Cinq 1000 Shoe Cabinet brings order and refinement to everyday entry spaces. It combines discreet footwear storage with an elevated, architectural form that feels calm, organised, and modern.

features.title: Contemporary silhouette for organised entryways
features.text: The Cinq shoe cabinet’s clean geometry and understated styling allow it to integrate seamlessly into entryways, living areas, or alongside other Cinq storage units while maintaining a refined visual presence. Its versatile neutral finish blends naturally into a variety of décor themes, helping create a cohesive and composed living environment.

features.title: Tubular steel frame for elevated durability
features.text: The elegant tubular steel structure introduces a light architectural character while ensuring dependable support and long-term structural stability.

features.title: Dedicated footwear storage for clutter-free spaces
features.text: Designed to discreetly tuck away footwear, the cabinet helps maintain tidy entry zones while keeping everyday essentials easily accessible.

features.title: Raised design for visual openness
features.text: Elevated from the ground, the cabinet maintains an airy appearance while allowing convenient floor cleaning underneath.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
